2.50.2 Matrix.Style
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Matrix.Style element specifies the style information for a Matrix. This element is optional and is
of type Style.
Following is the parent element of the Matrix.Style element.
Parent elements
Matrix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Matrix.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
